title: 第十五章 血玉第十六章 乱葬岗
content_zh:
铁蛋盯着小荷扩散开的瞳孔，在床底又静等了一会儿，听到一阵脚步声。
两个婆子推门进来，看到‘小荷’的尸体也一声不吭，熟练得拔出短刀乱剁，把那少女毁了容，肢解了，收拾碎尸和地上散落的金银首饰，一股脑扔进那衣箱里，擦干地上的血迹。
看她们娴熟的动作，和杀猪似的，显然是‘湘竹姐’吩咐来处理后事的。
铁蛋眼珠一转，掐诀御钱，把掌中攥着的一把金钱暗暗抛洒出去，绕到屋外，叮叮当当洒落一地。
两个婆子立刻警觉，停下手中动作，对视一眼，一个贴向门口，一个望向窗外。
铁蛋又把诀一掐，金钱叮当当碰撞，咕噜噜向外滚去的声响，清晰无比得传入众人耳中。
“什么人！”
两个婆子立刻开门跳窗，冲向屋外。
铁蛋也抓紧时机，四足贴地，平平得从床底游出来，一猫腰钻入藏尸的衣箱里，和‘小荷’的断指碎肉蜷在一起，把箱盖盖紧。
不一会儿两个婆子便回来了，她们自然没抓到人，但也心知肚明，大概是行踪被什么人偷看到，不能再耽搁了。
于是两人把衣箱用符贴了，并力一抬，闷不做声得离开‘小荷’的闺房。
铁蛋捂着嘴，屏着气，尽量不发出一点声息，只听那两个婆子步履匆匆。
听刚才的对话，如果猜的不错，‘小荷’是个家里受宠的丫鬟，那‘湘竹姐’也是偷偷摸摸把人打死，大概不会当着家丁的面，把她埋在外院里作花肥，应该会带到城外，寻个乱葬岗丢了，到时候就说她偷偷放火，卷了家财与人私奔，也死无对证。
但还没走两步，好像还没离开史家内院，两个婆子突然停下脚步，把衣箱放下了。
铁蛋眯起眼，暗暗凝聚剑力。
然后“咚”得一声，有人踹了衣箱一脚，接着传来个尖嗓子的声音。
“箱里装着什么？”
“回公公的话，是些女人家用的东西……”
“打开。”
“这……”

“锃！”
一剑刺来，穿过铁蛋大腿，登时见了血。
铁蛋眯起眼，立刻一指点住穴道止血，一声不吭。
而外头那‘公公’抽剑出去，看看剑上的血，冷笑道，
“呵，女人家的东西是吧！打开！”
“且慢，程档头，可是有什么误会。”
这时外头传来‘湘竹姐’的声音。
“少废话！藏头露尾装什么装！打开！”
只是这‘程档头’尖嗓子叫嚷得虽然凶狠，‘湘竹姐’却也不惧他，慢条斯理，阴恻恻道，
“公公不必如此，这箱中不过是个杖毙的家奴罢了，不值一提。倒是档头都在府内做客三个月了，我家到底有没有窝藏钦犯，还不清楚么？老这样纠缠下去，面上也不好看吧。”
“呵呵，史湘竹，你不用在这装腔作势，梁州府就是你们史家的地盘！我手下的番子分明看到钦犯进了城，眼下不知去向，必是你们藏匿了！”
‘湘竹姐’恍然大悟，
“哦，原来如此，所以昨夜是公公派人潜进来，烧了我家的书楼，就是想趁乱搜查钦犯啊，那我得赶紧禀报家主才是。”
“你胡说八道什么！区区一个贱婢！竟敢拿都尉威胁咱家！”
“呵呵，公公想哪里去了，其实是有人在太岁头上动土，我已星夜飞鸽传书，通知家主和诸位供奉长老知道，急召关外大军回城。
现在既然知道是一场误会，是公公动的手脚，那可不得赶紧通知他们，率兵回营，免得几位主子回来，发现有人想搜我家女眷内宅，生出什么误会来，到时候可就闹得不好看了，您说呢。”
“你！……哼，好，好！史家劳苦功高，忠心为国！咱家一定记着，好让厂公知道！我们走！”
“不送。”
外头那‘湘竹姐’‘程档头’针锋相对，逼逼了好一阵，这一关总算是过了。
铁蛋感觉到衣箱又被人抬了起来，开始往城外走，但却没有丝毫放松，反倒愈发紧张，额头上竟渗出丝丝冷汗。

那阉人随手一剑，刺穿了他的大腿，现在一条腿已经不能发力，怕是不止伤着他血管，腿上肌腱也被伤着了。
这会儿虽然点穴掐着，但鲜血依然渗个不停，大腿一片温湿，半边裤子都被血水浸润，这整日整夜的煎熬，又这样失血，头又昏昏沉沉的，真的精力不济了。
好在铁蛋也见过伤兵急救，四处一摸，从‘小荷’碎尸上扯了些绢布丝绸，紧紧裹住伤口，又摸了些金簪珠串的，把大腿死死扎住，时不时用簪子往手心刺一下，咬着牙勉力支撑，免得失血太多，昏厥过去。
浑身染血的少年，就和残肢断臂的少女，挤在狭小的箱子里颠簸，‘小荷’的头颅，滚到铁蛋胸前，睁着双眼，白花花的脑浆顺着额前流下，盯着铁蛋的瞳孔，仿佛在朝他欢笑，欣喜还有个同伴，与她共赴黄泉。
content_en:
Tiedan stared at Xiaohe's dilated pupils, waited quietly under the bed for a while, and heard footsteps.
The two women pushed the door open and came in. When they saw the body of 'Xiao He', they didn't say a word. They skillfully pulled out a short knife and chopped it randomly, disfigured and dismembered the girl. They collected the broken body and the gold and silver jewelry scattered on the ground, threw them into the suitcase, and wiped the blood on the ground.
Judging from their skillful movements, they looked like they were killing pigs. It was obvious that they were ordered by 'Sister Xiangzhu' to handle the funeral arrangements.
Tiedan rolled his eyes, made a hand to control the money, secretly threw the handful of money in his palm out, walked around the outside of the house, and jingled to the ground.
The two women were immediately alert, stopped what they were doing, looked at each other, one leaned toward the door, and the other looked out the window.
Tiedan pinched the secret again, the money jingled, and the sound of Gululu rolling outward could be heard clearly in everyone's ears.
"Who!"
The two women immediately opened the door, jumped out of the window, and rushed outside.
Tiedan also seized the opportunity and swam out from under the bed with his four feet flat on the ground. He ducked into the suitcase where the body was hidden, curled up with the broken fingers of 'Xiao He', and closed the lid tightly.
After a while, the two women came back. Of course, they didn't catch anyone, but they knew very well that someone had probably seen their whereabouts, so they couldn't delay any longer.
So the two of them sealed the suitcase with charms, lifted it up, and left 'Xiao He''s boudoir in silence.
Tiedan covered his mouth, held his breath, and tried not to make a sound, only listening to the hurried steps of the two women.
Listening to the conversation just now, if your guess is correct, 'Xiao He' was a maid who was favored by the family, and 'Sister Xiangzhu' also secretly beat people to death. She probably wouldn't have buried her in the outer courtyard in front of the servants to be used as flower fertilizer. She would have taken her outside the city and found a mass grave and lost it. Then they would say that she secretly set fire to someone and eloped with the family property. There is no proof.
But before taking two steps, as if they had not left the inner courtyard of the Shi family, the two women suddenly stopped and put down their suitcases.
Tiedan narrowed his eyes and secretly concentrated his sword power.
Then there was a "boom", someone kicked the suitcase, and then there was a sharp voice.
"What's in the box?"
"If I go back to my father-in-law, they are some things used by women..."
"Open."
"This..."
"Zhi!"
A sword stabbed through Tiedan's thigh and blood immediately appeared.
Tiedan narrowed his eyes and immediately pointed at the acupuncture point to stop the bleeding without saying a word.
The 'father-in-law' outside drew his sword out, looked at the blood on the sword, and sneered,
"Oh, it's a woman's thing, right? Open it!"
"Wait a minute, Cheng Dutou, but there is some misunderstanding."
At this time, the voice of ‘Sister Xiangzhu’ came from outside.
"Stop talking nonsense! What are you pretending to be with your head hidden and your tail exposed! Open it!"
It's just that although this 'Cheng Dutou' screamed fiercely with a high-pitched voice, 'Sister Xiangzhu' was not afraid of him and said slowly and sadly,
"You don't have to be like this, father-in-law. What's in this box is just a house slave who was beaten to death. It's not worth mentioning. But the stall owner has been a guest in the house for three months. Isn't it clear whether my family is harboring criminals? It won't look good if we continue to be entangled like this."
"Haha, Shi Xiangzhu, you don't need to be pretentious here. Liangzhou Mansion is the territory of your historian family! My subordinates clearly saw the imperial invaders entering the city and they are nowhere to be found. You must be hiding them!"
‘Sister Xiangzhu’ suddenly realized,
"Oh, I see, so my father-in-law sent people to sneak in and burn down my library last night, just to search for the culprit during the chaos. Then I have to report it to the head of the family as soon as possible."
"What nonsense are you talking about! You're just a cheap servant! How dare you threaten our family with the captain!"
"Haha, what are you thinking, father-in-law? In fact, someone is making trouble on Tai Sui's head. I have sent a letter to the head of the family and all the worshiping elders in the starry night, and to urgently summon the troops outside the customs to return to the city.
Now that we know that it was a misunderstanding and that the father-in-law was responsible, we must hurry upInform them and lead the troops back to the camp, lest the masters come back and discover that someone wants to search the inner house of my female family members. If there is any misunderstanding, it will be ugly by then. What do you think? "
"you! ...Hmph, okay, okay! The historians worked hard and served the country loyally! Our family must remember it so that the factory owner knows! Let's go! "
"No. "
The 'Sister Xiangzhu' and 'Cheng Tatou' outside were tit-for-tat and forced each other for a while, but they finally passed this level.
Tiedan felt that the suitcase was being lifted up again and started to walk out of the city, but he did not relax at all. Instead, he became more and more nervous, and cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
The eunuch casually pierced his thigh with a sword. Now one of his legs could no longer exert force. It was feared that not only his blood vessels but also the tendons on his legs were injured.
Although he was pinching his acupuncture points, blood was still seeping out. His thighs were warm and wet, and half of his pants were soaked with blood. After suffering all day and all night, he was losing so much blood, and his head was dizzy. He really lost his energy.
Fortunately, Tiedan had also seen first aid for injured soldiers. He felt around and pulled some silk cloth from the broken body of 'Xiao He', and wrapped it tightly around the wound. He also touched some gold hairpins strung with beads, and tied his thighs tightly. From time to time, he pricked the palms of his hands with the hairpins, and gritted his teeth to hold on, so as not to lose too much blood and faint.
The blood-stained boy and the girl with broken limbs were jostled together in a small box. Xiao He's head rolled to Tie Dan's chest. Her eyes were open, and the white brain matter was flowing down her forehead. She stared at Tie Dan's pupils, as if she was smiling at him. She was happy to have a companion who would go to hell with her.
